headlines.text: On this day in 2020, Thunder Rosa vs. Ivelisse etched their names into history in the first-ever NWA World Women's Title match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.16. A fierce, evenly-matched title defense that reportedly turned real at points ? the two exchanged actual shoot-style strikes mid-match, a rare moment of true tension bleeding through the performance, before Rosa retained with a Tombstone piledriver.
That Saturday in 2023, Bill & Starks kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.21 ? a solid showing.

It was 2020 when Best Friends vs. Proud-N-Powerful fought it out in a Parking Lot Fight match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 8.95 ? a match fans still talk about in a back-and-forth tag team affair. A postponed Parking Lot Fight finally delivered, straight out of the ECW hardcore playbook ? car hoods, steel batons, and a cannonball senton off a windshield, in a rescheduled brawl originally meant for Blood & Guts.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2020, Ben Carter competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Scorpio Sky, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.69 ? a match that delivered.
That Saturday in 2023, Kris Statlander vs. Britt Baker put the AEW TBS Title on the line, appearing on Collision, rated 7.21 ? a strong outing.
Turning the clock back to 2020: Dynamite stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.59.
